items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: So I was so glad to see him, so I told him I had just taken up studying Christian Science. So he showed me how to do the lessons.

ctx.x: had to learn how to do the lessons. So we was going to some town. We met in a town somewhere in Virginia or somewhere. He had to be in town. So I was so glad to see him, so I told him I had just taken up studying Christian Science. So he showed me how to do the lessons. Because I hadn't done a lesson before. I was just reading pamphlets and things on it. Then I heard a lecture that got me into studying it.
Yeah. It certainly couldn't do anybody any harm, and it certainly did some wonderful... You mentioned something about Solomon, too, didn't you.
